data.name: Beasley
data.long_meaning: The name Beasley is derived from the old English name Bosweal or Boswel, meaning 'boswell', which referred to someone who tended to the boar hogs. Alternatively, it could be derived from the Old English word 'beoseleig', meaning 'bee meadow'. This name has a strong connection to the English language and has no known biblical or spiritual origins.
